objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle stages. Represents policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other document types.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The user-defined title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short abbreviation prefix for the document type used in naming (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (Level 1-4).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated date until which the document remains valid, based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period for validity checks, default is 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable time period for how long an invalidated document is archived before physical deletion, default is 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person assigned as the primary author responsible for creating the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned with write permissions on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) authorized to approve and release the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers can view the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Organizational areas or scopes where the document applies.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The organizational or functional scope of the document.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: In a multi-client system, specifies in which clients the document is visible.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document, used for non-critical supplementary information such as brief instructions, photos, or screenshots.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Publication status controlled via switches in the properties, released and published directly without a release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment that is automatically released with the release of the main document. Subject to its own versioning and passes through the release process statuses of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment, subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment following the main document's release process statuses.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by authors to suggest changes to an existing released document, without affecting the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: editing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation of how the change proposal was processed by the document author.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document that no longer has validity, triggering the archiving process and revocation of authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override (invalidation) request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its original properties and authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign read or change authorizations, distribution lists, and role-based access to documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: The type or purpose of the user group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document who are automatically informed about releases, maintained per document for email notification or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email notification or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: document_type_definition
objs.description: A configurable classification defining the type and level of documents, with associated abbreviations, templates, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The type abbreviation used in document naming conventions.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for extended validity checks, typically 3 years.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: Default archive retention period, typically 10 years.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A documented signature captured during workflow steps, recording approval decisions by workflow participants for each released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the signature was applied.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The workflow step (Creator, Review, Release) at which the signature was given.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a user that they have read and noted a released document, tracked via workflow-supported process without signature.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: acknowledged_by
attributes.description: The person who confirmed acknowledgement.

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translator on documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the person.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: The license role assigned to the person (e.g., READER, AUTHOR).

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation report providing filtered search results and document status information based on selection parameters.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The type of report (e.g., Status Report, Search, Acknowledgement Report).

attributes.name: target_role
attributes.description: The role for which the report is designed (e.g., Reader, Author).

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that must go through its own review and release workflow before being visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The target language of the translation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The workflow status of the translated version (e.g., in review, released).

attributes.name: reviewer_for_translation
attributes.description: Person assigned to review the translation.

attributes.name: releaser_for_translation
attributes.description: Person assigned to release the translation.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated through the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The Office format used for editing (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving, and the current version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal correctness and completes the review task with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: The outcome of the review (approved or rejected).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document with an electronic signature, making it visible to addressed readers.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: The outcome of the release (approved or rejected).

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval process, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created when changes are made to content, attributes, or attachments.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for the new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal scheduled).

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is attached to a document, not subject to the release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is directly deleted from a document without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document without affecting the document's content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the change proposal, marking it as completed and triggering an email notification to the proposal creator.

attributes.name: editing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation of how the change proposal was processed.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirms the extended validity of the document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted after validity is extended or a new version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a released document that no longer has validity.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The override request is approved through the workflow, declaring the document Out of Force and initiating archiving.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are archived by revoking all authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation request, creating a new version of the document and restoring its original properties and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document via the properties dialog.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email notification or acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution being maintained (by email or for acknowledgement).

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: An automatic email notification is sent to users on the distribution list upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, persons on the acknowledgement distribution list are automatically requested by email to confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document through a workflow-supported process without signature.

evts.name: create_translation
evts.description: A translation of a released document into another language is created.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A reviewer checks the translated version of the document for correctness.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: The outcome of the translation review (approved or rejected).

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the translated version, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: The outcome of the translation release (approved or rejected).

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: A role-specific evaluation report is generated based on selected parameters and selection criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The type of report generated.

o2o.description: Each document belongs to a document type definition that determines its abbreviation, level, validity period, and archive duration.
A document can reference other documents via the references attribute.
An additional information object is attached to and belongs to a main document.
A controlled attachment belongs to a main document and is released with it.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within it.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
A request for override is created for a specific document to be invalidated.
A request for reactivation references the specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
A distribution list is maintained per document for controlling release notifications and acknowledgements.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list to receive notifications or acknowledgement requests.
Individual persons can be assigned directly to a distribution list.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type definition.
Reader authorization for a document is assigned via user group assignment in the Reader attribute.
Persons are assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, or releaser.
Electronic signatures are documented for each released version of a document.
An electronic signature is provided by a specific person.
A translation is a language-dependent version of a released document.
An acknowledgement confirms that a user has read and noted a specific released document.
An acknowledgement is confirmed by a specific person.
A user group contains individual persons who inherit the group's authorizations.
